ValueError: Piecewise renders at 224px only, and asking for 256 is not a resolution change. Every length in the reference is in output pixels — a 4 px border, a door half-extent in pixels, a Gaussian sigma in pixels, a wall at column 112 — with no world-unit description underneath, so there is nothing to re-sample. Resize the frames afterwards if a different size is wanted; that is what stable_worldmodel's own pipeline does.
